title: Bitcoins Node Surge: Decentralization Hits New Peak
content: TL;DR: Bitcoin's global node count has reportedly reached new highs, reinforcing the network's decentralization and resilience. This growth, coupled with robust security metrics like a current hashrate of 1043.09 EH/s and a difficulty of 146.47 T, underscores Bitcoin's unwavering commitment to its role as the hardest, most censorship-resistant money, contrasting sharply with the inherent vulnerabilities of centralized financial systems.
author: Al Ingle
tags: Bitcoin Nodes, Mining, Decentralized Finance, Lightning Network, Network Resilience, Innovation, Regulation, Technology
seo_title: Bitcoin Nodes Hit Record: Decentralization Soars
seo_description: Bitcoin's node count surge maxes decentralization and resilience, reinforcing its status as secure, censorship-resistant digital money.
